name: Document and Command Engine
description: The document model (Document > Scene > Layer > Shape, keyframe tracks, fills, text shapes, ruler guides, the W1 layer masks and track mattes, text runs with paragraph and path-text styles and their text layout, colour and shape tracks, the swatch palette, metadata, frame labels) and its ModelError; LayerOwner, which addresses a scene's or a symbol's layer list; the Command protocol and CommandEngine with exact undo/redo, groups, coalescing, an undo depth limit and layer-scoped validation for single-layer commands; the CommandRegistry that decodes any command from a JSON envelope; the built-in command families (scene, layer, shape, text, keyframe, label, guide, swatch, metadata), with the stroke, path and duplicate-layer commands, scene canvas, rename and reorder; and the .flare v1 file format with validation. Every document change goes through a Command.

relationships.description: shapes and layers are placed with Transform and Path
keyframe tracks carry easing; commands keep keyframes sorted
